run_metadata.coverage_summary: Degraded, SEARCH-ONLY run. The same hard egress constraint seen on every recent run persisted: the session network policy denied all direct HTTPS to tender hosts. WebFetch returned DNS ENOTFOUND for every host attempted (www.tenders.gov.au, www.australiantenders.com.au, www.tamworth.nsw.gov.au) — hosts outside the session's allowed network domains. No buyer-originated portal, detail page, feed/API or tender document could be opened, so discovery was limited to the WebSearch tool (US-indexed, returning mostly cached snapshots, JavaScript-disabled portal shells, and third-party aggregator pages such as australiantenders.com.au and developmentaid.org). Tier 1 (AusTender; NSW buy.nsw/eTendering; VIC Buying for Victoria; QLD QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au; WA/SA/TAS; NT QTOL; ACT) were swept by search only. Tier 2 (councils via VendorPanel and own sites; universities; Sydney/Melbourne Water and other GBEs; public health) checked by search. Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery/Business Network; BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside; major retail/bank/telco buyer portals) checked by search — every corporate channel remained registration-gated or invitation-only with no publicly-visible open RFx. Two buyer-originated government opportunities that appeared genuinely open and recent (published within the last 7 days) were surfaced and corroborated across multiple independent reports (NSW master media RFT; Transport for NSW New England Highway Maitland Westbound Upgrade ROI), plus one still-open carryover (Woomera Redevelopment EOI, ICN Gateway). All carried at headline level and flagged UNVERIFIED against the primary portal, since no detail page or document could be opened. No opportunity, deliverable, date, value or contact was fabricated; leads that resolved to closed or invitation-only notices were excluded and noted in gaps.
gaps: HARD EGRESS BLOCK: all direct HTTPS to tender hosts denied by the session network policy (WebFetch DNS ENOTFOUND — hosts outside allowed domains). This has now blocked full discovery on multiple consecutive runs. To restore full discovery, at minimum these hosts should be allowed in the session network settings: www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au and buy.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au, qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au / supply.qld.gov.au, www.tenders.wa.gov.au, www.tenders.sa.gov.au, www.tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, www.tenders.act.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, service.ariba.com, gateway.icn.org.au, transport.nsw.gov.au, australiantenders.com.au, and individual council/university sites.

All three carried tenders are UNVERIFIED headline-level entries drawn from cached search snippets and trade-press/aggregator reports; their tender_id, buyer detail, exact dates and scope could not be confirmed on the buyer-originated primary portal this run. They need a detail/verification pass once egress is restored.
No deliverables / requirements / evaluation-criteria extraction was possible for any opportunity — every detail page and tender document was unreachable.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, Telstra, major banks) remained registration-gated or invitation-only; no authenticated supplier session is available, so no corporate opportunity could be read. Recorded as portals only, consistent with prior runs. No corporate tender was fabricated.

Prior-run AusTender entries DFAT-1039 (PNG ESIP 2 RFT, closing 18 Nov 2026) and AM-14207 (AIFFP EOI Project Procurement Specialist, closing 18 Nov 2026) remain in the aggregate with future closing dates but were NOT re-surfaced or re-verified this run due to the egress block; they are likely still open until 18 Nov 2026 but are not re-asserted as active in this snapshot.

Excluded leads (not fabricated): New England Highway Westbound Upgrade at Maitland — Market Interaction Process (MIP) closed 22 July 2026 (superseded by the current ROI) — excluded. RFT26-001/004/005 EOI series (Ports of the Future; Sustaining Infrastructure; Submarine Cable Systems) all closed 13 Sep 2026 — excluded. GovCMS Drupal/DXP Services Panel (Dept of Finance) closed 7 Oct 2026 — excluded. Various council tenders (Tamworth, Tweed, Toowoomba, Maranoa, Logan) surfaced only with December-2025/early-2026 closing dates already passed — excluded.
WebSearch is US-indexed and returned predominantly stale or aggregator data; genuinely recent (last 24-48h) buyer-originated notices are almost certainly undercounted this run.

tenders.title: NSW Government Master Media Services — Request for Tender (Stage 1)
tenders.category: Media strategy, planning and buying services
tenders.description: NSW Government has opened a two-stage tender for its whole-of-government master media account (media strategy, planning and buying). Stage 1 RFT is open and, per multiple trade-press reports, closes 27 November 2026; the account is estimated at around $80 million. This round has been opened to independent agencies, which may bid alone or as a consortium.
tenders.scope_of_work: Reported scope: provision of media strategy, media planning and media buying and related services for the NSW Government's consolidated advertising account. Not confirmed against the primary tender documents (egress blocked).
tenders.eligibility: Open; this round has been opened to independent agencies which may bid individually or as a consortium (per IMAA and trade-press reports). Exact eligibility/pre-qualification unconfirmed against the primary notice.
tenders.value: ~$80,000,000 (estimated annual spend; reported, not confirmed from the notice)
tenders.submission_method: Via NSW Government tenders portal (buy.nsw / NSW eTendering) — unverified
tenders.reasoning: Surfaced via WebSearch and corroborated across multiple independent Australian trade-press reports (Mediaweek, B&T, Mumbrella) that NSW Government has opened a Stage 1 RFT for its ~$80m master media account, closing 27 Nov 2026, now open to independent agencies, with a shortlist expected Jan 2027 and Stage 2 in Feb 2027. Buyer-originated source is the NSW Government tenders portal; the primary portal could not be opened this run (egress block), so recorded at headline level from media reports.
tenders.notes: UNVERIFIED — tender_id, publish date, exact closing time, evaluation criteria and the full scope/deliverables could not be confirmed on the NSW Government primary portal (egress blocked). Dates and $80m value come from trade-press reporting. Verify and extract deliverables from the RFT documents on buy.nsw / NSW eTendering once network access is restored.

tenders.title: New England Highway — Maitland Westbound Upgrade — Registration of Interest (ROI)
tenders.description: Transport for NSW has invited suitably experienced and qualified organisations with design and construction capability to register their interest in the New England Highway — Maitland Westbound Upgrade. The ROI (published 9 November 2026) is the first stage of a three-phase procurement process involving development of a concept design followed by design and construction of the project. A reported closing date of 11 December 2026 could not be confirmed against the primary notice.
tenders.scope_of_work: Reported scope: upgrade of the westbound movement at the Cessnock Road roundabout on the New England Highway at Maitland to ease congestion and support housing and population growth in the Maitland and Cessnock council areas. Procurement structured in three phases: concept design development, then design and construction. Not confirmed against the primary tender documents (egress blocked).
tenders.eligibility: Organisations with demonstrated design and construction (D&C) capability; registration via the ROI process. Exact prequalification requirements unconfirmed against the primary notice.
tenders.submission_method: Registration by email; submissions must use the email subject 'MWU: Procurement Process - ROI Submission' (reported). Lodgement mechanics unconfirmed against the primary notice.
tenders.delivery_location: Maitland / Cessnock region, New South Wales
tenders.reasoning: Surfaced via WebSearch; the buyer-originated owner is Transport for NSW (project page and eTendering notice). An aggregator listing (tender ref 26.0000139291.0941.ROI) indicates publication on 9 Nov 2026 and a three-phase D&C procurement; the Transport for NSW project page supplied the contact email and phone. Recorded against the buyer's own source, not the aggregator. Primary notice could not be opened this run (egress block).
tenders.notes: UNVERIFIED — closing date (11 Dec 2026) and closing time come from an aggregator snippet (the aggregator's closing-date field was blank in one result); publish date and tender ref also from aggregator. Contact email/phone from the Transport for NSW project page. Scope, requirements and documents not confirmed. Verify and extract detail from the Transport for NSW eTendering / buy.nsw notice once egress is restored. An earlier Market Interaction Process (MIP) for the same project closed 22 July 2026 and is excluded.
